run_inference_pipeline: run the inference pipeline to generate synthetic data from a HuggingFace dataset using vLLM
run_progress_monitoring: run progress monitoring to track generation and update the dataset card with a progress bar and ETA
generate_dataset_card: generate a final dataset card with generation statistics after inference completes
run_local_inference: run the inference pipeline locally on a GPU with --local-execution flag
run_slurm_inference: run the inference pipeline on Slurm with --enable-monitoring to track progress
